text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE  :- (English) 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires threads to be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, but the drawing contains no thread dimensions or features at all.
